RagShortTexts: Vannius depends on local families and settlements.
Neighboring kin do not make every feud a common obligation.

Variants.Content: Vannius needs local families and settlements. Neighboring kin make negotiation easier without obliging everyone to join each feud.

Vannius depends on local families and settlements. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Neighboring kin do not make every feud a common obligation.
Neighboring kin do not make every feud a common obligation. Coordination allocates actual supply and protection duties, not merely titles. Vannius depends on local families and settlements.
Vannius depends on local families and settlements. Households compare burdens with neighbors; unmatched protection weakens cooperation. Neighboring kin do not make every feud a common obligation.

Neighboring kin do not make every feud a common obligation. One promise may not bind every receiver, guard and supplier; negotiation needs actual responsibility. Vannius depends on local families and settlements.
